description: Defines the AIConfiguration class with methods and members related to AI system configuration in a plugin namespace.

classes.name: AIConfiguration
classes.description: Class managing AI system configuration parameters and methods.

methods.name: getAppsCpuSet
methods.description: Returns the CPU set for apps as a bitset.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppMemoryLimit
methods.description: Returns the memory limit for non-home apps.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppGpuLimit
methods.description: Returns the GPU limit for non-home apps.

methods.name: getAppsRequiringDBus
methods.description: Returns list of apps requiring D-Bus.

methods.name: getResourceManagerClientEnabled
methods.description: Checks if resource manager client is enabled.

methods.name: getGstreamerRegistryEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GStreamer registry is enabled.

methods.name: getEnableUsbMassStorage
methods.description: Checks if USB mass storage is enabled.

methods.name: getDialServerPathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the dial server path prefix.

methods.name: getIonHeapQuotas
methods.description: Returns Ion heap quotas as a map.

methods.name: readFromCustomData
methods.description: Reads configuration from custom data source.

methods.name: readFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads configuration from a config file.
